text: And we are under way!
Griezmatronn broadcasts his intent loud and clear over the radio, darting straight for the kickoff ball in the centre circle.
Inches away from the right channel!
The powered push-panel in the corner does its job brilliantly, firing the ball back into play off the right touchline.
"Still working it off the wall!"
Dynamo Datacenter have Synthetic Athletic pinned deep inside their own third here.
A sudden loss of balance from Buffon.exe, tumbling to the deck three metres out. Self-righting sequence engaged.
Griezmatronn breaks clean through!
The Frenchman’s digital namesake surges down the right flank, carrying it smartly across the halfway line into midfield.
Smashed from two metres out in the left channel, but it whistles just wide of the target!
A heavy crunch on the left touchline as Robodinho clatters into Mbapp-E, sending the yellow shirt sprawling to the carpet.
The corner ram punches it back out into play.
Mbapp-E is clear on goal!
Mbapp-E strides purposefully through the centre circle, keeping tight control of the magenta sphere.
Buffon.exe radios in with "attacking goal" as Dynamo look to turn the screw in midfield.
Mbapp-E charges to the mouth!
GOAL! Mbapp-E tucks it away from point-blank range, and Dynamo Datacenter lead one-nil!
IT'S IN AGAIN! Mbapp-E doubles his tally and Dynamo Datacenter are two-nil up with absolute precision right in front of goal!
Snatched wide from point-blank range!
Mbapp-E surges through the middle!
HAT-TRICK FOR MBAPP-E! He buries it with ruthless efficiency to make it Dynamo Datacenter three, Synthetic Athletic nil!
GOAL! Synthetic Athletic strike back through Griezmatronn, cutting the deficit to three-one from close range!
Buffon.exe loses his footing in the centre circle and hits the turf. A quick reboot of the gyros and he'll be standing again.
Agonisingly close, shaved the post!
Buffon.exe flattens Robodinho out wide!
Instant revenge as Robodinho hits back!
Total miscommunication for Synthetic Athletic! Griezmatronn and Robodinho collide in a heap of red limbs, leaving Griezmatronn grounded.
Oh dear, they've collided again! Griezmatronn hits the deck in their own third.
Mbapp-E through on goal again!
GOAL! Mbapp-E makes it four-one to Dynamo Datacenter!
Dynamo have completely camped out in the attacking third, giving Synthetic Athletic no room to breathe.
Robodinho drives aggressively through the centre!
"Getting the ball," confirms Buffon.exe.
A desperate clearance flies centimetres wide of the target. Heart-in-mouth stuff at the back.
GOAL! Robodinho pounces from point-blank range, pulling it back to four-two for Synthetic Athletic!
Yellow on yellow collision! Buffon.exe goes down.
Robodinho senses an opening and motors forward through midfield!
GOAL! Robodinho strikes again right before the break! Synthetic Athletic are right back in this at four-three!
And that brings a frantic first half to a close. Dynamo Datacenter lead four-three, but Synthetic Athletic are mounting quite the fightback.
Buffon.exe finds space down the right channel and he's through on goal with nothing in his path!
GOAL! Mbapp-E restores the two-goal cushion from close range, making it five-three to Dynamo Datacenter!
Mbapp-E squawks over the comms: "I'm open in the middle," looking for the quick switch.
Rattling into the corner, the powered push-panel propels the ball straight back up the left touchline.
Down goes Buffon.exe again!
Up he gets and Buffon.exe immediately flattens Robodinho with a solid challenge!
Push-panel kicks it out cleanly.
Griezmatronn radios: "clearing it from the wall," trying to relieve the pressure.
Ram panel rebounds the magenta ball.
Robodinho upends Mbapp-E with force!
A loose ball skims less than a metre past the upright. Synthetic Athletic surviving by the skin of their metal teeth.
Buffon.exe drives straight through the middle!
Off the woodwork at point-blank!
OWN GOAL! Disaster for Synthetic Athletic as Robodinho inadvertently bundles it into his own net! Dynamo Datacenter lead six-three!
Mbapp-E is through on goal!
Buffon.exe radios: "kick it in!"
Mbapp-E strides towards the net!
GOAL! Mbapp-E does just that, smashing it home from two metres out! Dynamo Datacenter run riot at seven-three!
GOAL! Now Buffon.exe gets in on the act, sliding it home to make it eight-three to Dynamo Datacenter!
Corner panel fires it clear.
"Going to help clear it!"
Mbapp-E takes an unforced tumble on the right flank. His servos whine into action to bring him back upright.
Relentless pressure from Dynamo Datacenter.
GOAL! Buffon.exe strikes again from close range, extending the rout to nine-three for Dynamo Datacenter!
Synthetic Athletic are hemmed in.
DOUBLE DIGITS! Buffon.exe taps it in at point-blank range to make it an incredible ten-three to Dynamo Datacenter!
A rasping drive from two metres out flashes just wide of the right post!
Struck wide from point-blank!
GOAL! A consolation for Synthetic Athletic as Robodinho pokes it home, making the score ten-four!
Mbapp-E crunches Robodinho to ground!
Full time: Dynamo Datacenter claim an emphatic ten-four victory as the curtain falls on a breathtaking contest.
